predictions.rationale: Primary class representing the State Diagram in the original ArgoUML diagram package; central to creation, storage, and manipulation of state diagrams.
Graph model that backs the State Diagram, managing states and transitions as graph nodes/edges—core for behavior representation.
Responsible for drawing/rendering the State Diagram elements (states, transitions) on screen, directly supporting the feature’s visualization.
UI action that creates a new State Diagram; essential for user interaction with the feature.
Initialisation logic that registers and sets up State Diagram components (graph model, renderer, actions) at application startup.
Figure class that graphically represents an individual State within the State Diagram, fundamental to diagram content.
Figure class for transitions between states; key visual element of state diagrams.
Helper providing model-level operations for UML state machines; underpins the semantics of state diagrams.
Alternative/newer implementation of State Diagram in the state2 diagram subsystem, relevant for extended or refactored functionality.
Factory responsible for creating instances of the new State Diagram variant, enabling feature integration in the modular architecture.
